question: can the D-frame ladder be repaired by rescaling z_D to bar-evenness?
answer: No. The rescaling exists and is forced (z_D/q^2 = 1/[2]_q), but a bar-even parameter cannot satisfy the full-bar condition that DEFINES convention D, so the route leaves D rather than re-deriving within it. The live route remains the derived projection a - h^2/4.
scope: (b) — exact symbolic identities. Closes one alternative; adjudicates nothing about the live route.
note_on_the_0_4_percent: z~_D is 0.4% from z_C while raw z_D is 23% away, which is why the C-built ladder nearly works under z~_D. That closeness is NOT evidence and was not used: the verdict is the full-bar incompatibility, established independently of it.

assertions.name: bar_even_exponent_is_forced_not_chosen
assertions.detail: bar(q^a z_D)/(q^a z_D) = q^(-2*a - 4), so bar-evenness forces a = -2 uniquely; z~_D = z_D/q^2 = q/(q**2 + 1), and bar(z~)/z~ = 1.

assertions.name: the_two_bar_laws_are_the_same_identity
assertions.detail: bar(z_D) = q^-4 z_D (multiplicative, as derived from scratch) and bar(z_D) = z_D - h (additive, as the corpus states it) differ by exactly 0. They look like two conditions and are one. Worth recording because a reader meeting both forms could think two separate constraints apply.

assertions.name: z_C_and_z_tilde_D_are_the_same_form_in_different_variables
assertions.detail: z_C = 1/[2]_sqrt(q) and z~_D = z_D/q^2 = 1/[2]_q — the same functional form in q vs sqrt(q), structurally the same shape as the (u;u)_m vs (q;q)_m convention defect fixed in #6906.

assertions.name: bar_even_normalisation_LEAVES_convention_D
assertions.detail: z_D's defining property is the full-bar condition bar(z) = z - h (zD_full_bar_covariant). z~_D misses it by exactly q - 1/q, i.e. h — and so does z_C. barEven_fullBar_forces_classical proves this is not an accident: bar-even and full-bar are incompatible away from q^2 = 1. So rescaling to bar-evenness does NOT re-derive the ladder within D; it moves to a third parameter that is neither z_C nor z_D. THE ROUTE IS CLOSED.

assertions.name: defect_is_exactly_h_squared_reproducing_the_corpus
assertions.detail: bar(2a) + 2a = h^2 exactly at z_D, independently reproducing QOU.QBeta.eigenphase_bar_defect_of_fullBar. Since the defect is z-independent across the full-bar family, no choice inside it restores bar-oddness — which is why the live route is the derived projection a - h^2/4, not a reparametrisation.
